description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Bamunawela, Kurunegla D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/55037)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land registration information including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, land extents, and certificate of title numbers for multiple properties across different districts. The content focuses entirely on land title settlement procedures for deceased persons' properties, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) as defined in the specialized categories.
